title: Declaration of the Sabarimala Pilgrimage as a sacred pilgrimage recognized by the Government of Sr Lanka and provision of facilities
decision_details: - For a long time, Sri Lankan Hindu devotees have been taking part in pilgrimages to the famous Sabarimala Ayyappan Kovil in Kerala, India, every year from 1st  November to 31st  January of the following year. This has now become a spiritual pilgrimage attended by over 15,000 Sri Lankan devotees annually. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to declare the pilgrimage by Sri Lankan Hindu devotees to the Sabarimala Ayyappan Kovil in Kerala of India as a sacred pilgrimage recognized by the Government of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.
